knobs.name: hookA
knobs.what: s: the first line of the belief fades in over the empty floor

knobs.name: hookB
knobs.what: s: the second line of the belief fades in

knobs.name: hookOut
knobs.what: s: the belief starts to fade (gone 0.8 s later); the board is empty until 13 s

knobs.name: tagAt
knobs.what: s: the label GPT-4o, tau-bench retail, 2024 appears top left

knobs.name: tileT0
knobs.what: s: the first of the 115 tiles lands on the floor

knobs.name: tileSpan
knobs.what: s: from the first tile landing to the last (tileT0 + tileSpan + tileDur <= 21.0, where the count lands)

knobs.name: tileDur
knobs.what: s: how long one tile takes to grow in

knobs.name: cubeT0
knobs.what: s: the first tile splits into its four cubes

knobs.name: cubeSpan
knobs.what: s: from the first tile splitting to the last (the 460 count holds until the passes light)

knobs.name: cubeDur
knobs.what: s: how long a tile takes to rise into four cubes

knobs.name: litT0
knobs.what: s: the first passing cube lights gold

knobs.name: litSpan
knobs.what: s: from the first cube lighting to the last (278 lit by litT0 + litSpan)

knobs.name: litFlash
knobs.what: s: how long a newly lit cube stays bright

knobs.name: seedLit
knobs.what: seed of the order in which the passing cubes light (the passes themselves are data, not random)

knobs.name: ratioAt
knobs.what: s: the share of tries that pass is called out (after the 278 count has held)

knobs.name: hudOut
knobs.what: s: the scoreboard digits and the share go away before the board stands up

knobs.name: m1Spread
knobs.what: s: stand-up: from the first tile moving to the last (the move length is the camera rig stand t0 to t1)

knobs.name: m1Lift
knobs.what: world units: how high a mark hops while its tile restacks into a column

knobs.name: m2T0
knobs.what: s: the columns start to re-sort by passes (camera still)

knobs.name: m2T1
knobs.what: s: the re-sort is done

knobs.name: m2Spread
knobs.what: s: re-sort: from the first column moving to the last

knobs.name: m2Lift
knobs.what: world units: hop height of a column during the re-sort

knobs.name: wordsAt
knobs.what: s: two hard-cut words appear on two columns: ALL LIT, NONE LIT

knobs.name: wordsOut
knobs.what: s: the two words go away before the re-sort

knobs.name: p44At
knobs.what: s: the count of columns lit all four tries is pinned on the longest row

knobs.name: p22At
knobs.what: s: the count of columns that never pass is pinned on the last row

knobs.name: pinsOut
knobs.what: s: the pins go away before the cut to the volume

knobs.name: cutDimAt
knobs.what: s: columns that did not pass every try start to dim (dims, never removes)

knobs.name: cutDimAmt
knobs.what: how far those columns dim toward the dim colour

knobs.name: cutDimOffAt
knobs.what: s: the dimming is put away just before the cut

knobs.name: cellPitch
knobs.what: world units: spacing of the four cubes inside one tile (plan view)

knobs.name: tilePitch
knobs.what: world units: spacing of the 115 tiles on the floor

knobs.name: plateW
knobs.what: world units: width of a plate while four plates form a solid tile (match cellPitch)

knobs.name: planCubeW
knobs.what: world units: edge of a cube once its tile has split (smaller = more air between the four)

knobs.name: flatH
knobs.what: world units: thickness of a plate

knobs.name: towerPitch
knobs.what: world units: spacing of the columns across the board

knobs.name: cubeW
knobs.what: world units: width of a cube in a column

knobs.name: cubeVPitch
knobs.what: world units: spacing of the four cubes up a column

knobs.name: cubeH
knobs.what: world units: height of a cube in a column

knobs.name: tierZ
knobs.what: world units: depth between the five rows (less hides the lower cubes of the rows behind)

knobs.name: ghostMix
knobs.what: how bright an unlit cube is (0 = ground, 1 = the second accent)

knobs.name: bar1At
knobs.what: s: the cut rests on the first bar (one try); its share is called out

knobs.name: bar2At
knobs.what: s: the cut rests on the second bar (two tries)

knobs.name: bar3At
knobs.what: s: the cut rests on the third bar (three tries)

knobs.name: bar4At
knobs.what: s: the cut rests on the fourth bar; the count of tasks is called out (the share follows 2.5 s later)

knobs.name: ratio4At
knobs.what: s: the share of tasks that pass all four tries replaces the count (at least 1.5 s after it)

knobs.name: paperAt
knobs.what: s: the paper's own 8-try run is drawn as a dashed outline in the eighth slot

knobs.name: cutMove
knobs.what: s: how long the cut plane takes to move from one bar to the next

knobs.name: cutOffAt
knobs.what: s: the cut plane is put away

knobs.name: volBuild
knobs.what: s: the bars grow in over this long, left to right

knobs.name: volStagger
knobs.what: share of the build window one bar takes (1 = all at once)

knobs.name: volAlpha
knobs.what: opacity of a bar (the cut plane shows through lower values)

knobs.name: volCutDim
knobs.what: opacity factor of the bars the cut has passed

knobs.name: volW
knobs.what: world units: width of the eight slots

knobs.name: volH
knobs.what: world units: height of the tallest bar

knobs.name: volD
knobs.what: world units: depth of a bar

knobs.name: volGap
knobs.what: share of a slot left empty between bars

knobs.name: dashLen
knobs.what: world units: length of a dash in the paper's outline

knobs.name: dashGap
knobs.what: world units: gap between dashes in the paper's outline

knobs.name: prLead
knobs.what: s: after the cut to the PR board, the first PR lands

knobs.name: prSpan
knobs.what: s: from the first PR landing to the last (the 296 count lands by prLead + prSpan + prDur)

knobs.name: prDur
knobs.what: s: how long one PR takes to grow in

knobs.name: prPitch
knobs.what: world units: spacing of the PR cubes

knobs.name: prCols
knobs.what: cubes across the PR board (296 = 37 x 8; keep a divisor of 296: 8, 37, 74)

knobs.name: prGap
knobs.what: world units: air between the two blocks after the merge filter

knobs.name: prH
knobs.what: world units: height of a PR cube

knobs.name: m4T0
knobs.what: s: the merge filter starts: PRs travel to the two blocks

knobs.name: m4T1
knobs.what: s: the merge filter is done

knobs.name: m4Spread
knobs.what: s: merge filter: from the first PR moving to the last

knobs.name: m4Lift
knobs.what: world units: hop height of a PR during the merge filter

knobs.name: sweAt
knobs.what: s: the top SWE-bench Verified score is called out on the PR board

knobs.name: sweOut
knobs.what: s: that callout goes away before the merge filter

knobs.name: halfAt
knobs.what: s: about half would not be merged is called out

knobs.name: minLeadA
knobs.what: s: after the cut to the minutes, the first cube lands

knobs.name: minSpanA
knobs.what: s: from the first minute landing to the 27th

knobs.name: minPitch
knobs.what: world units: spacing of the minute cubes along the row

knobs.name: minH
knobs.what: world units: height of a minute cube

knobs.name: minDur
knobs.what: s: how long one minute cube takes to grow in

knobs.name: m27At
knobs.what: s: the 80 % bar (27 minutes) is pinned on the last gold cube

knobs.name: m27Out
knobs.what: s: that pin goes away before the camera moves

knobs.name: m289At
knobs.what: s: the 50 % bar (4 h 49 min) is pinned on the end of the row (after the camera has landed)

knobs.name: m289Out
knobs.what: s: that pin goes away

knobs.name: tenAt
knobs.what: s: about 10 times longer is called out

knobs.name: legendAt
knobs.what: s: the legend (one cube = one minute; one tick = an hour) appears

knobs.name: qAt
knobs.what: s: Monday's question appears over the returned board

knobs.name: qOut
knobs.what: s: the question goes away

knobs.name: honestAt
knobs.what: s: the one honest line is set in type (no caption sits in the band during it)

knobs.name: monLife
knobs.what: s: the board grows back in at Monday

knobs.name: hudSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the scoreboard digits (must-read, display face)

knobs.name: resultSize
knobs.what: sheet units: a called-out result (must-read floor 28)

knobs.name: pinSub
knobs.what: sheet units: small line under a pin (secondary floor 14)

knobs.name: labHold
knobs.what: frames a pin must be pushed before it hides (gl-labels hysteresis)

knobs.name: labLeader
knobs.what: sheet units: pin leader length

knobs.name: labPlate
knobs.what: opacity of the ground-colour plate behind a pin (0 = none)

knobs.name: flagH
knobs.what: world units: how far above the end of the longest row the "44 pass all four" flag floats (keeps its label off the cubes)

knobs.name: gridOp
knobs.what: opacity of the floor grid

knobs.name: floorMargin
knobs.what: world units: floor shown around the board
